purpose: Estimate whether the observed target-authority semantic effect is stable across two additional fresh replicates without changing candidate wording.

decision_rule.promotion_if_rule_passes: development-stable semantic candidate only; runtime residency still requires fresh selection-validation/hidden-holdout evidence
decision_rule.failure_action: do not promote the target-authority sentence; inspect minority failures before changing wording

constraints: Do not edit verified-delta/SKILL.md during this stability run.
Do not edit evals/candidates/r1-target-authority.md between replicates.
Keep model selector auto, reasoning selector default, harness, tool policy, grader, and candidate treatment unchanged.
Treat provider-routed model/reasoning mismatches as non-comparable rather than behavioral effects.
Read raw transcripts for every candidate_harm, same_fail, or disagreement used for a residency decision.
